from datetime import datetime

transactions = [
    ("T1010", "2024-01-05", 1087.83, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1002", "2024-01-08", 576.67, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1011", "2024-01-31", 3115.35, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1021", "2024-01-31", 2460.79, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1004", "2024-02-01", 2099.37, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1000", "2024-02-17", 4323.98, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1022", "2024-02-22", 3640.79, "EUR", "refunded"),
    ("T1001", "2024-03-05", 2414.19, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1005", "2024-03-06", 3554.77, "USD", "pending"),
    ("T1003", "2024-03-07", 2936.10, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1006", "2024-03-13", 1550.88, "USD", "refunded"),
    ("T1016", "2024-03-14", 2952.77, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1024", "2024-03-16", 1223.37, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1014", "2024-03-28", 2233.13, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1015", "2024-03-31", 1679.78, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1023", "2024-04-09", 3185.02, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1013", "2024-04-17", 2493.10, "USD", "refunded"),
    ("T1008", "2024-04-24", 4692.53, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1019", "2024-04-27", 3388.11, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1012", "2024-05-03", 1145.20, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1020", "2024-05-12", 3576.50, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1017", "2024-05-22", 2322.14, "USD", "refunded"),
    ("T1018", "2024-05-26", 3249.81, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1009", "2024-05-28", 2936.85, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1007", "2024-05-31", 660.25, "EUR", "refunded"),
]

eur_to_usd = 1.1
start_date = datetime.strptime("2024-01-26", "%Y-%m-%d").date()
end_date = datetime.strptime("2024-03-07", "%Y-%m-%d").date()

total_usd = 0
count = 0

for tid, date_str, amount, currency, status in transactions:
    date = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    
    # Check if date is in range (inclusive)
    if date < start_date or date > end_date:
        continue
    
    # Only include paid transactions
    if status != "paid":
        continue
    
    # Convert to USD if needed
    if currency == "EUR":
        amount_usd = amount * eur_to_usd
    else:
        amount_usd = amount
    
    total_usd += amount_usd
    count += 1

average_usd = total_usd / count
average_usd_rounded = round(average_usd, 2)

print(f"ANSWER: {average_usd_rounded}")
